items.title: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted PDF file that triggers memory corruption.

items.title: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via vectors involving access to an invalid pointer after the deletion of an object. The impacted product could…

items.title: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

items.title: Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

items.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.

items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

items.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

items.title: Bypassing Windows authentication reflection mitigations for SYSTEM shells - Part ②
WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared) Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
items.summary: WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.
